sources.citation: Clark, Brenda R. 2017. A Grammatical Sketch of Sivia Sign Language. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa. hdl:10125/62503 (370 pp.)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: online with a university library login
sources.note: Phonology/prosody chapters (5-6, 10.7) describe Sivia Sign Language only. Section 2.2.2 'Inmaculada' (pp. 20-21) is the only passage on LSIn: a sociolinguistic and lexicostatistic note (used by signers who attended CEBE La Inmaculada de Barranco before 1960; 56-75% shared Swadesh vocabulary with LSP; ASL influence up to 16%; dialect chain by age). Nothing on LSIn phonology, prosody or stress.
